verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Feature Change Requests as a four-eyes create/approve/publish workflow for flag updates. Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production, and RBAC can limit who may modify production environments. missing for 10: documentation that approvals can be enforced as mandatory per environment (e.g., required approver counts), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Feature Change Requests help creating a four-eyes workflow (create, approve, publish) to updating feature flags, similarly to Pull Requests in GitHub.
Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
